company.name: Deepcell
company.shortDescription: Deepcell is a life science company specializing in AI-powered single-cell classification and isolation for basic and translational research.
company.description: Deepcell provides software for single-cell dimensional morphology analysis. They also provide an AI-powered imaging and microfluidics platform that identifies and isolates viable cells based on morphological distinctions for use in translational research, diagnostic testing, and therapeutics.

productsAndServices.description: An integrated instrument and software platform for label-free, high-dimensional single-cell imaging, AI-based morphology analysis, and gentle six-way sorting of viable cells.
productsAndServices.name: REM-I Platform

productsAndServices.description: A send-in research service that provides academic users with AI-based single-cell morphology analysis and publication-grade imaging data without requiring an REM-I instrument.
productsAndServices.name: Deepcell Express

productsAndServices.description: A sample-based proof-of-concept service combining REM-I imaging, label-free cell sorting, high-dimensional morphology analysis, and scientific consultation.

productsAndServices.description: Collaborative services for integrating REM-I into clinical, translational, and bioprocessing programs through codevelopment and joint validation studies.

aiResearchSummary.text: Deepcell is engaged in developing methods and systems for cell analysis, as described in 'Methods and systems for cell analysis,' which details a cartridge with fluid and pneumatic ports for processing cells. 'Systems and methods for particle analysis' outlines imaging devices capturing multi-angle cell images for analysis. 'Compositions, systems, and methods for multiple analyses of cells' describes imaging, staining, and rotating cells for detailed examination. These efforts focus on advanced single-cell classification and isolation.
